$comment: One realm whose capital grows its own quarters: auto-scale stays on (no `quarters` field, so the mundus does not turn it off) and a local realm's quarter takes 10 members, so the swarm's 15 people fill the capital and the realm asks Casals for a quarter by itself. Its members vote that quarter_add; geister's branch counts the realm's own proposals as the administration's (until it is merged, a swarm on main follows a leader and votes most of them down). `realms mundus up autoscale`. See docs/development/mundus.md for every field.
name: autoscale
